SMTO-GWT-0043 — The model wasn't started because the Gateway is restarting

GUID: c7629ed7-1209-4a9e-ad1e-a062143df93c
Slug: gateway-restart-in-progress
Domain: GWT · Subsystem: gwt

What happened

  • SMTO asked this computer to start an AI model while the Gateway there (the helper program SMTO uses on that computer) was in the middle of restarting. This request did not start the model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait a minute, then open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check connection for that computer until it shows Connected. The Gateway refuses to start models until its restart has finished.
  2. Ask SMTO in a conversation to show the status of the local AI models on that computer. After a restart, a model that was running before may start again on its own.
  3. Only if the model is not running, ask SMTO once to start it. Starting a model that is already running could start a second copy or restart it.

What success looks like

  • The computer shows Connected, and the model's status shows it running.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages that computer's Gateway. Don't keep sending start requests while it is restarting; each one will be refused.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • GatewayService.llm_start refused a managed model start (409) because a Gateway restart or shutdown was already pending.

What this means

  • Managed-model startup checked the Gateway's pending-restart flag and refused a new start while restart was in progress. The retained phase, target and receipt determine what executed. Rendering this definition adds no probe, retries, dispatch or changes to resource ownership.

Why this can happen

  • Managed-model startup checked the Gateway's pending-restart flag and refused a new start while restart was in progress.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the restart status and existing managed processes; this rejection does not establish whether an earlier model start succeeded.

How to fix it

  • Wait for the Gateway to come back (health check or Settings › Setup › Gateways shows Connected), then query the managed model status (/llm/status or Local AI runtimes) before issuing a single new start; managed models may resume their previous running state after a restart. Do not loop start requests while _RESTART_PENDING is set.
  • Wait for Gateway readiness, then inspect the model service state before requesting a start.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Gateway readiness returns and the existing model state is known before a new authorized start.

What not to do

  • Do not use a rapid retry loop or replay an uncertain mutation while waiting for the stated condition.

Technical notes

  • The retained phase, target and receipt determine what executed. Rendering this definition adds no probe, retries, dispatch or changes to resource ownership.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
